Hey 👋 ,
I'm reusing the work done on this branch so we can release it with another dataset (we're going with Algolia's blog data). 

Preview → https://deploy-preview-3915--instantsearchjs.netlify.app/examples/media/

There are differences between the two datasets that require some changes:

| Old dataset | New dataset | Notes |
| ----------- | ------------- | ------ |
| categories | coauthors |  |
| topics | categories |  |
| locations | N/A |  |
| date | N/A | Can be added back later if the dataset is updated with this attribute |
| sortBy | N/A |  |

I also edited the wording and added more info regarding the authors (avatar and job title).

Still needs to be done:

- [x] remove unused components from codebase
- [x] update dependencies

Let me know if I missed something.
I don't know why the codesandbox build failed or how to restart it if necessary. Is there a way to get more detailed logs from them?

We are tracking the page in the URL, but don't have showPrevious and/or infiniteHitsCache enabled, meaning https://deploy-preview-3915--instantsearchjs.netlify.app/examples/media/?PROD_algolia_blog%5Bpage%5D=3 for examples doesn't show the first results at all

> We are tracking the page in the URL, but don't have showPrevious and/or infiniteHitsCache enabled, meaning https://deploy-preview-3915--instantsearchjs.netlify.app/examples/media/?PROD_algolia_blog%5Bpage%5D=3 for examples doesn't show the first results at all

I didn't notice that. I'll add a button to show previous results in this case.
This is a nitpick, but the date & category filters don't look the same, because of the padding on the search box. Not sure how to solve that tbh, as the padding is *inside*
I made some adjustments related to the alignment issue  and the "previous results" CTA, thanks to input from Nana.
